feedback.problem:
The center of the hyperbola $\frac{(y-3)^{2}}{49}-\frac{(x+8)^{2}}{36}=1$ is$\,\,($
{{field-1}}$,$
{{field-2}}
$).$
feedback.worked_solution:
The equation of a vertical hyperbola centered at $(h,k)$ is given by

$$
\frac{(y-k)^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{(x-h)^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Note that the given equation can be rewritten as follows:

$$
\frac{(y-3)^{2}}{{7}^{2}}-\frac{(x-(-8))^{2}}{{6}^{2}}=1
$$

In this case, we have $h=-8$ and $k=3.$

Therefore, the center of the hyperbola is $(\,-8,3\,).$
